parameters.name: BackupObjectType
parameters.description: The object type of the backup sets to be queried.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, which takes effect in a pagination query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of rows to return on each page.
- Maximum value: 100.
- Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The backup start time, in the format of *yyyy-MM-dd* T *HH:mm:ss* Z (UTC time).

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the backup sets to be queried.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-data-backup-set --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --status DONE --backup-object-type tenant --start-time 2022-12-27T16:00:00Z --end-time 2023-01-06T15:59:59Z --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeDataBackupSet --region cn-hangzhou --Status DONE --EndTime '2023-01-06T15:59:59Z' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --BackupObjectType tenant --PageNumber 1 --StartTime '2022-12-27T16:00:00Z'
